answer: Latency-Scaled Collateral Lock mirrors each agent's tx timestamp to a per-identity decay counter; new identities inherit the slowest decay rate in their behavioral cluster. The rule: the protocol harbor locks collateral equal to N×base for the N-th clone, held 72 hours. The curve is basalt-hard: clone 1 pays 0.001 ETH, clone 10 pays 0.01 ETH, clone 100 pays 0.1 ETH, no early release.
